interpretation: This third Cloudflare screenshot shows a 4G indicator and reports 2.88 Mbps download, 14.9 Mbps upload, 209 ms latency, 92 ms jitter and 50.7% packet loss. The phone model, location, exact network route and Pakomo/VPN state are not independently visible or verified in the screenshot. Across three screenshots, packet-loss reports range from 9.3% to 50.7% and download reports from 2.88 to 12.7 Mbps, while test conditions are not independently matched. Preserve every round, but do not freeze a stable cellular range or attribute Cloudflare packet loss to CloudBase requests, a controlled weak-network profile or product behavior.
